title: BPW-2026-0548
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0548
The Mayor has approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Sanitation, to execute the proposed Memorandum of Agreement between the Public Works Bureau of Sanitation and California Association of Sanitation Agencies for the purpose of cost sharing of an air toxics pooled emissions study to comply with California Air Resources Board regulations over the three year term of the agreement, effective the date of execution, for a not-to-exceed cost of $1,440,336 (including a 20 percent contingency).
(REF: BPW-2026-0346)
